steps.what: Gather inspection evidence, observed violations and corrective recommendations for the report
Write detailed reports describing the inspection, evidence and recommendations

loop.purpose: Draft factual report prose without deciding violations or remedies
loop.input: Inspector's evidence brief and required report sections
loop.output: Source-linked draft with explicit missing information
loop.check: Compare descriptions, attributed observations, code references and recommendations with inspector-confirmed evidence
loop.stop: One draft and correction; unresolved sections are written manually
loop.why_not_simpler: Inspection narratives vary; templates supply headings but cannot compose all factual explanations

steps.what: Verify and issue the final inspection report with its supporting evidence

tasks.design: Use the existing {DOCS} report template and a bounded narrative draft from inspector-confirmed evidence. The inspector verifies every finding and recommendation before issuing the exact report through the existing channel.
tasks.previous_blocker: Observed evidence had to be repeatedly translated into formal report prose.
tasks.enabler_now: Source-bound drafting can propose factual wording while preserving the existing reporting process.
tasks.still_hard: A fluent draft can change the apparent severity, attribution or basis of a finding.
tasks.human_edge: The inspector knows what was observed and can defend the actual recommendation.
tasks.altitude: Some prose-writing time returns to checking evidence and the precision of findings.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: source-bound fire inspection report drafting is plausible; the digest provides no named inspection-report drafting product or measured saving.

assumptions: Boundary is report preparation after inspection and corrective-action decisions. Those activities remain separately owned and are not saved again.

The inspector captures and checks in s1 inspection identifier, site, date, observation, location, evidence reference, verified applicable provision and already-determined recommendation. Capture time stays counted. Missing or disputed facts require manual clarification; the model cannot create violation or severity flags.
Use native document templates and existing case fields before adding a drafting loop; no automatic enforcement or report release.
Five incremental focal hours cover template changes and omission audits; two other-role hours cover access upkeep.
unknowns: Current report format and typing workload
Local requirements and inspector release authority
research_questions: Does checked drafting reduce total reporting time without altering observation, severity or recommendation?

already_counted.description: Compare draft claims with inspection evidence

incremental.description: Maintain report instructions and audit omissions

approvals.approved_version: Exact report text, evidence attachments, provisions, recommendations and recipient; changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B100 R89.5 gives10.5 gross minus5 focal upkeep =5.5 net. Complex disputed findings or already templated reports reduce conservative saving to0-2%.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Determine and explain corrective fire-safety actions

steps.what: Identify corrective actions from observed conditions and applicable fire requirements
Explain corrective actions and clarify property owners' questions about required measures

tasks.design: Keep corrective-action decisions with the inspector using the current requirements library in {DOCS}. Retain direct explanation to the owner; report transcription is handled as a separate task.
tasks.previous_blocker: Remedies depend on property conditions and the actual applicable requirements.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing requirement libraries support retrieval, but they do not establish correct remedies automatically.
tasks.still_hard: Alternative measures, disputed findings and misunderstood instructions require contextual judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The inspector can explain why a measure is needed and recognize an unsafe interpretation.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in corrective-action authority or explanation time.

reach.task: Explain preventive measures associated with observed building hazards

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: corrective-action choice and owner explanation retain human time; the applicable national and local requirements must be verified for each property.

assumptions: Boundary covers remedy determination and explanation, excluding original inspection and separate formal report writing.

The inspecting officer produces observed findings before this task. In counted s1 the inspector checks property use, requirement version, relevant conditions and evidence before choosing remedies; missing applicability or disputed evidence prompts manual investigation. No precomputed compliance flag is assumed.
Use the native requirements library before custom retrieval or decision software.
Zero incremental upkeep because no new automation or additional record obligation is proposed.
unknowns: Authority to select and communicate measures
research_questions: Is any repeated retrieval overhead distinct from judgement and explanation measurable?

already_counted.description: Explain and clarify measures with the owner

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 upkeep0 net0. Familiar remedies and disputed property conditions both retain the actual judgement and explanation.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop or review fire exit plans

steps.what: Develop or review fire exit plans against actual building conditions and occupant needs

tasks.design: Keep exit-plan development and review with the inspector, using {DOCS} plans and verified site information. Existing drawing templates can support presentation while the person evaluates routes and practical use.
tasks.previous_blocker: A drawing cannot establish that the actual building and occupant conditions match it.
tasks.enabler_now: Versioned drawings provide context without replacing the substantive plan review.
tasks.still_hard: Changed layouts, blocked routes and occupant limitations require local assessment.
tasks.human_edge: The inspector recognizes when a formally complete plan would fail in practice.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in plan-review responsibility or assumed time.

reach.role: First-Line Supervisors of Firefighting and Prevention Workers
reach.task: Discuss operational limitations of an exit arrangement

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: fire exit planning and review need contextual assessment; the digest establishes no autonomous plan-review saving.

assumptions: Boundary is exit-plan development and review, excluding evacuation execution and separately owned site inspections.

Building staff produce current layouts and occupancy information before review; the inspector checks currency, route conditions, occupant needs and requirements during counted s1. Missing or inconsistent plans trigger manual verification, never automatic acceptance.
Test native drawing and document tools before custom plan checking.
Zero incremental upkeep because no new automated checker or recurring reporting process is introduced.
unknowns: Plan currency and local review requirements
research_questions: Is there a separately measurable drawing-format task after substantive decisions are complete?

already_counted.description: Assess conditions, develop routes and review the plan

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 upkeep0 net0. Routine updates and difficult layouts both retain substantive review; existing drawing runtime receives no saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Coordinate efforts with other organizations, resolving responsibilities, information needs and operational constraints

tasks.design: Keep coordination through existing {EMAIL} and {TELEPHONY} channels with the inspector responsible for information sharing and commitments. Retain clarification and confirmation of the other organization's response.
tasks.previous_blocker: Coordination depends on changing priorities and responsibilities across organizations.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing communication channels enable contact without removing the need for agreement.
tasks.still_hard: Agencies may have different authority, evidence needs and disclosure constraints.
tasks.human_edge: The inspector negotiates practical cooperation and recognizes unresolved responsibility.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in coordination responsibility or assumed human time.

reach.task: Clarify evidence needs and handoff responsibilities

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: substantive interagency coordination remains human work; automated message delivery does not establish an agreement.

assumptions: Boundary is the inspector's coordination, excluding partner agencies' own work, dispatch decisions and separate case-report preparation.

The inspector checks case facts, recipient identity and permitted disclosure during counted s1. Partner contacts produce their responses after contact; the inspector obtains clarification before treating responsibilities as agreed.
Use native communication records before custom coordination software.
Zero incremental upkeep because no new automation or extra status-report requirement is introduced.
research_questions: Is there repeated duplicate status entry distinct from the coordination conversation?

already_counted.description: Contact, clarification and confirmation of responsibilities

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 upkeep0 net0. Routine agency contact and contested responsibilities both retain human coordination; partner response time is not a focal labour saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Checked narrative drafting may reduce report typing while corrective decisions, exit-plan review and coordination retain expert ownership.
reach: Maintain precise evidence descriptions with records officers
Clarify operational and evidence handoffs with protective-service colleagues
role.ambitious_version: An inspector whose reports remain traceable to observations and whose decisions and coordination remain accountable.
